description: Reviewed fixes for lsrd_dictionary.db, applied by tools/apply_dictionary_fixes.py. Only text printed in the official PDF is used; values derived from a sibling entry carry a 'note'.
rules: update: replaces one field of one row; 'old' must match the database (or the row already holds 'new').
merge_split: one printed headword stored as several rows; the kept row gets the full headword and every reference of the fragment rows, then the fragments are deleted.
delete_divider: a row made from a letter-divider page; references move to the letter's own sign, then the row is deleted.
add_synonym: a name printed inside a merged headword becomes a sinonimos_mapeo entry.
flag: the PDF itself lacks the field; the row keeps requiere_revision=1.
Second-sign rows keep the printed caption ('SEÑA NUMERO DOS', or 'SEÑA NÚMERO DOS' on pp.39, 41, 43, 58) as definition; their category is inherited from the first sign (note on each op).
